name: application-identity
title: 应用层：身份认证与会话
description: 收敛用户、密码、Session、Token、登录注册和认证授权业务，保持 Web/API 认证语义。
creator: wanfeng
notes: Implementation gate: user confirmed all PRD P-01..P-08 recommendations on 2026-09-10. Identity consumed persistence transaction/compensation, outbox, TTL/index, token compatibility and unique-identity contracts plus focused fixtures; AC-P2..AC-P6 Mongo/mail/protected-runner evidence remains partial and is not to be presented as identity completion. Review repair 2026-09-10: copy_notes generic compensation now tracks actual copied note IDs and resets per Apply attempt; focused regression passed. Second review repair 2026-09-10: login/find-password user lookups now use error-returning seams, storage errors no longer map to invalid credentials or accepted reset requests; ThirdRegister uses (ThirdType, ThirdUserId), writes ThirdType and returns zero user on registration failure; Captcha persists and checks SetCaptcha before writing PNG. P-08 is implemented in the focused persistence/session contract as SHA-256 SessionId lookup, legacy 24-char ObjectId transition and shared resolver/logout semantics; Golden/live replay and log/backup exposure evidence remain downstream. P-01/P-05/P-06/P-07 fixtures and downstream numeric Code/message/redirect mapping remain implementation evidence, not unresolved product decisions. P-02/P-03/P-04 are confirmed current baselines (no CSRF, query/form token, _ID+Captcha) with risks owned downstream. branch=base_branch=dev is the repository's documented single-branch workflow; it is not a blocker. This task remains in_progress until cross-layer evidence gates close.
